title: A covering-strip and moment certificate for Korenblum's constant
summary: We give an explicit certificate for c_2>=54/125=0.432, where c_2 is Korenblum's constant for the Bergman space. This is an unrefereed preprint. The construction combines an elementary two-zero Schwarz estimate on the covering strip of an annulus, the classical hyperbolic Jung inequality, and Wikström's moment-duality criterion. A rational twelve-atom measure with a Lebesgue tail satisfies the required inequalities for every moment index.
